Class JsonRepository

java.lang.Object
repositories.JsonRepository
Direct Known Subclasses:
AttackRepository, BugemonRepository, CustomBugemonRepository, ItemRepository, TeamRepository
public abstract class JsonRepository extends Object
Abstract base repository providing generic JSON serialization utilities.

Three operations are exposed:

  • readJSONFromAssets(String, Class) — reads read-only data packaged on the classpath (game data such as Bugémons, attacks, items).
  • readPersistenceData(String, Class) — reads mutable user data from a filesystem path (saved teams, custom Bugémons).
  • updatePersistenceData(String, JsonRepository.JsonWrapper) — writes mutable user data to a filesystem path.

Subclasses must define an inner wrapper class implementing JsonRepository.JsonWrapper to use any of the read methods.

  • Method Details

    • readJSONFromAssets

      protected static <W extends JsonRepository.JsonWrapper<T>, T> List<T> readJSONFromAssets(String path, Class<W> wrapperClass) throws JsonResourceNotFoundException
      Reads a JSON file from the classpath, deserializes it into the given wrapper class, and returns the list exposed by that wrapper via JsonRepository.JsonWrapper.getItems().
      Parameters:
      path - the classpath-relative path to the JSON file
      wrapperClass - the wrapper class mirroring the JSON structure
      Throws:
      JsonResourceNotFoundException - if the file is not found in the classpath

    • readPersistenceData

      protected static <W extends JsonRepository.JsonWrapper<T>, T> List<T> readPersistenceData(String path, Class<W> wrapperClass) throws JsonPersistenceLoadingException
      Reads a JSON file from the filesystem and returns the list it contains. Returns an empty list if the file does not exist.
      Parameters:
      path - the filesystem path to the JSON file
      wrapperClass - the wrapper class mirroring the JSON structure
      Throws:
      JsonPersistenceLoadingException - on I/O error or malformed JSON

    • updatePersistenceData

      protected static void updatePersistenceData(String path, JsonRepository.JsonWrapper<?> wrapper) throws JsonPersistenceSavingException
      Serializes the given wrapper to a JSON file on the filesystem, creating any missing parent directories.
      Parameters:
      path - the filesystem path where the JSON file will be written
      wrapper - a populated wrapper holding the data to serialize
      Throws:
      JsonPersistenceSavingException - on I/O error
